scope_and_privacy_boundaries.evidence_origin: Preserved qualifications from the immutable October assessment; not newly verified schema fields or current legal guidance.
scope_and_privacy_boundaries.all_registered_vs_active: The all-registered narrative conflicts with active-only comparison wording. Preserve both; no statewide denominator or completeness claim is established.
scope_and_privacy_boundaries.exclusion_qualification: The October assessment states these do not register; a registered-entity file cannot establish coverage of all operating businesses.
scope_and_privacy_boundaries.status: Registry standing and biennial reporting do not establish operating activity, establishment existence or current business operations.
scope_and_privacy_boundaries.address_roles: Keep principal-office, registered-agent and other service addresses distinct. Neither a principal-office filing nor a registered-agent address independently proves an operating establishment.
scope_and_privacy_boundaries.person_fields: Registered agents and other person-linked fields require a verified person-free projection and field-level privacy review before any future source processing.
scope_and_privacy_boundaries.zip: Keep ZIP5 and ZIP4 separate; preserve unknown or suppressed addresses as unknown and do not infer a ZIP or operating location.
scope_and_privacy_boundaries.residential_suppression: The October assessment preserves 2026 guidance permitting eligible remote businesses to exclude a residential address; current redaction fields and delivery behavior remain unverified.
scope_and_privacy_boundaries.cmra: CMRA disclosure requirements are distinct from residential suppression; do not infer that CMRA addresses are categorically withheld.
